lines.text: The proverb says like mother, like daughter, and Jerusalem's mother was a Hittite and her father an Amorite.
Samaria lived to the north and Sodom to the south, and Jerusalem soon became more depraved than they were.
Sodom was arrogant, overfed and complacent, and Samaria did not commit half of Jerusalem's sins.
God will restore Sodom and Samaria along with Jerusalem, who is now scorned by the daughters of Moab and the Philistines.
Jerusalem despised the oath by breaking the covenant, so God will establish a temporary covenant and make atonement for her.
